commonNames.name: Coppery Titi Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The coppery titi monkey (Plecturocebus cupreus) or red titi monkey is a species of titi monkey, a type of New World monkey, from South America. They are found in the Amazon of Brazil and Peru, and perhaps northern Bolivia.
wikipedia.title: Coppery titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: Neochen is a genus of birds in the family Anatidae.
wikipedia.title: Neochen

commonNames.name: Hubbard's Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Lepilemur hubbardorum Louis Jr., Engberg, Lei, Geng, Sommer, Randriamampionona, Randriamanana, Zaonarivelo et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: Hubbard's sportive lemur (Lepilemur hubbardorum), or the Zombitse sportive lemur, is a sportive lemur endemic to Madagascar. It has total length of about 51 to 59 cm (20 to 23 in), of which 23–25 cm (9.1–9.8 in) are tail.
wikipedia.title: Hubbard's sportive lemur

wikipedia.extract: Eurystomus is a genus of roller, one of the two genera in that family of birds. The name means ‘broad mouth’, from the Greek eurus (εὐρύς, ‘broad, wide’) and stoma (στόμα, ‘mouth’).
wikipedia.title: Eurystomus

wikipedia.extract: Daptrius is a genus of birds of prey in the family Falconidae comprising most of the caracaras. All members are endemic to South America, except for the yellow-headed caracara, which is also found in Costa Rica and Panama.
wikipedia.title: Daptrius

wikipedia.extract: The Apodiformes is an order, or taxonomic grouping, of birds which traditionally contained three living families—the Apodidae (swifts), the Hemiprocnidae (treeswifts), and the Trochilidae (hummingbirds); however, in the Sibley–Ahlquist taxonomy, this order is elevated to the superorder Apodimorphae, in which hummingbirds are separated into a new order, the Trochiliformes. With nearly 450 species identified to date, it is the most diverse order of birds after the Passeriformes (the "perching" birds).
wikipedia.title: Apodiformes

wikipedia.extract: Alisterus is a genus of medium-sized Australasian parrots, comprising the Australian king parrot (Alisterus scapularis), the Papuan king parrot (A. chloropterus) and the Moluccan king parrot (A. amboinensis). The three species are respectively found in eastern Australia, Papua, the Moluccas and other Indonesian islands.
wikipedia.title: Alisterus

wikipedia.extract: Animals are multicellular, eukaryotic organisms belonging to the biological kingdom Animalia (). Animals consume organic material, breathe oxygen, have muscle cells, can reproduce sexually, and grow from a hollow sphere of cells, the blastula, during embryonic development.
wikipedia.title: Animal

wikipedia.extract: Oryza sativa, having the common name Asian cultivated rice, is the much more common of the two rice species cultivated as a cereal, the other species being O. glaberrima, African rice. It was first domesticated in the Yangtze River basin in China 13,500 to 8,200 years ago.
wikipedia.title: Oryza sativa

wikipedia.extract: Mullerornis modestus is an extinct species of elephant bird, and the only member of the genus Mullerornis.
wikipedia.title: Mullerornis

commonNames.name: Saddle-back tamarin
commonNames.source: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil

wikipedia.extract: The brown-mantled tamarin (Leontocebus fuscicollis), also known as Spix's saddle-back tamarin, is a species of saddle-back tamarin. This New World monkey is found in the Southern American countries of Bolivia, Brazil and Peru.
wikipedia.title: Brown-mantled tamarin

commonNames.name: Black Squirrel Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The black squirrel monkey (Saimiri vanzolinii), also known as the blackish squirrel monkey or black-headed squirrel monkey, is a small New World primate, endemic to the central Amazon in Brazil. It largely resembles the female of the far more common Bolivian squirrel monkey, though the latter lacks the black central back.
wikipedia.title: Black squirrel monkey

commonNames.name: Kashmir Gray Langur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Kashmir gray langur (Semnopithecus ajax) is an Old World monkey, one of the langur species. It is a leaf-eating monkey.
wikipedia.title: Kashmir gray langur

commonNames.name: Bemanasy Mouse Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Microcebus manitatra Hotaling, Foley, Lawrence, Bocanegra, Blanco et al., 2016

wikipedia.extract: The Bemanasy mouse lemur, Microcebus manitatra, is a species of mouse lemur described in 2016 from Madagascar. It was discovered by a team of researchers at the German Primate Center.
wikipedia.title: Bemanasy mouse lemur
